build_drqv2_agent: build a DrQV2Agent with encoder, actor, and critic networks for image-based reinforcement learning
create_randomshiftsaug_augmentation: create a RandomShiftsAug module to apply random shift data augmentation on image tensors
create_encoder_network: create an Encoder CNN module that processes image observations into flattened feature representations
create_actor_network: create an Actor network that outputs a truncated normal distribution over actions given encoded observations
create_critic_network: create a Critic network with twin Q-heads that estimates action values from encoded observations and actions
